A Nigerian pedicurist, Olusanya Samuel, known as Sam Pedicures, is set to attempt a Guinness World Record for the longest pedicure marathon by an individual. The Anatomy graduate from FUOYE, Samuel is scheduled to undertake the 48-hour marathon from October 29 to 31, 2026, at Njay Beauty Spa & Salon, located at Akure, Ondo State. The event, according to a statement released on Tuesday, is aimed at showcasing the potential of Nigeria’s beauty and wellness industry and raising awareness about foot care and hygiene. Samuel, who is the founder of Sam Pedicures, said his background in anatomy had helped shape his understanding of human physiology and foot care. “My background in anatomy gave me a deeper understanding of human physiology and foot care structure. Samuel said his entrepreneurial journey began in his second year at university, when he started learning manicure and pedicure techniques. Over more than five years of practice, the venture grew from a side enterprise into Sam Pedicures, a brand focused on foot hygiene and professional foot care. The record attempt is also intended to encourage young Nigerians to develop practical skills and explore entrepreneurship alongside formal education. Organisers said the event would feature live entertainment, a red-carpet experience, food, drinks and free pedicure sessions for attendees. Samuel completed his primary and secondary education in Ondo State before studying Anatomy at FUOYE. He is the son of Olusanya Adeleke, from Epe, Lagos State, and Adubi Mercy, from Akunu Akoko, Ondo State. The proposed marathon comes as Samuel seeks to use his professional skills and the international attention associated with a Guinness World Records attempt to promote Nigeria’s personal care industry.
